prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A secondary battery includes a positive electrode having a positive electrode current collector and a positive electrode active material layer; a negative electrode having a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode active material layer; a separator interposed between the electrodes; a electrolyte; a positive electrode lead; and an insulating tape that covers part of the positive electrode. The positive electrode current collector has an exposed portion connected to the positive electrode lead. The positive electrode lead has an extending portion that projects from the exposed portion and an overlapping portion that overlaps the exposed portion. At least part of the exposed portion and at least part of the overlapping portion are covered with the insulating tape. The insulating tape has a substrate layer and an adhesive layer. The substrate layer contains a polyimide. The adhesive layer has an electrical resistance of 1 kΩ/mm2 or more at 500° C.

outputs.L4:
A secondary battery includes an electrode assembly having a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a separator disposed between the electrodes. The positive electrode includes a positive electrode current collector coated with a positive-electrode active material, together with a positive-electrode lead electrically connected to an exposed portion of the current collector. At least part of the region in which the positive-electrode current collector and the positive-electrode lead overlap is covered with insulating tape.

The insulating tape has a heat-resistant polyimide substrate and an adhesive layer formed on at least one surface of the substrate. The adhesive layer securely bonds the tape to the current collector and lead while retaining an electrical resistance of at least 1 kΩ/mm² when exposed to a temperature of 500°C. As a result, the tape continues to provide meaningful electrical insulation even under severe high-temperature conditions in which conventional adhesives may decompose, carbonize, or become electrically conductive.

By insulating the overlap region, the tape reduces the likelihood of unintended electrical contact between the positive-electrode lead or current collector and adjacent battery components. The polyimide substrate supplies mechanical strength and thermal stability, while the high-resistance adhesive layer helps prevent short circuits caused by heat-induced degradation. This construction therefore improves the reliability of the electrode connection and enhances battery safety during abnormal events such as overheating, internal short-circuiting, or thermal runaway.

### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest yet most important words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” can mean any book, while “the book” refers to a particular one that the speaker and listener recognize.

Despite its simplicity, “the” helps make communication clear and precise. It appears in everyday phrases, titles, and descriptions, quietly connecting ideas and guiding attention. Without it, many English sentences would sound incomplete or confusing.

The word also demonstrates how even the most ordinary parts of language can have great influence. It may contain only three letters, but “the” plays an essential role in shaping meaning.
